key_insight: This review highlights how AI-assisted thermoreflectance imaging can help map nanoscale thermal properties and reveal heat transport shaped by interfaces and defects.
engineering_relevance: Improved local thermal characterization could support materials discovery and thermal management in heterogeneous electronics and advanced manufacturing.
method: Use non-contact pump–probe thermoreflectance with wide-field imaging or scanning.
Apply AI-assisted processing to thermal-property mapping and interfacial transport visualization.
evidence_signal: The abstract summarizes recent advances but reports no datasets, quantitative accuracy metrics, or benchmark comparisons.
watch_item: Imaging throughput must be balanced against measurement accuracy and confidence in extracting multiple thermal parameters.
paper_title: Intelligent Imaging of Thermal Transport in Nanostructures
